description: Analytics pipeline caches query results in an unbounded dict with no TTL or eviction. Memory grows from 512MB to 4GB over 3 hours before OOM kill and pod restart.

known_root_cause.description: Query result caching feature stores results in module-level dict `_query_cache` with no max-size, TTL, or LRU eviction. Each unique query key persists forever. Under prod query diversity, cache grows unboundedly until OOM.

ground_truth.root_cause_summary: Unbounded query result cache introduced in deploy-analytics-028 accumulates 4GB of cached results over 3 hours — OOM kill at 3GB threshold

Memory usage: 2.6GB. Cache size: 91,200 entries. Major GC triggered.
GC pause: 2400ms. Service latency degrading during GC collection.
Memory usage: 3.4GB. OOM threshold approaching. Cache growing at 22MB/min.
Memory allocation failed for query result. Cache dict size: 147,000 entries. Process RSS: 3.9GB.
Memory usage 4GB. Datadog alert firing. Process approaching OOM kill threshold.
OOM Kill received. Pod analytics-pipeline-7d9f4 terminated. Kubernetes restarting.
Pod restarted. Memory usage: 490MB (cache cleared on restart). Issue will recur.
Cache repopulating. Without eviction policy, OOM will recur in ~3 hours.
